## 1️⃣ Restaurant Ordering Script  

> **Goal:** Communicate the need for *zero* wheat‑ or barley‑derived ingredients and *no* shared‑oil fried foods. The script follows the cross‑contamination safeguards described in [[concepts/cross‑contamination‑prevention]] and the gluten‑free cooking principles in the vegetarian menu [[summaries/session‑12_2024‑06‑15]].

| Step | What to Say (copy‑paste) | Why it matters |
|------|--------------------------|----------------|
| **A. Introduce the restriction** | “Hi, I have **celiac disease** and must avoid **all wheat, barley, and any foods cooked in shared oil**. Anything that has even a trace of gluten is unsafe for me.” | Sets the medical baseline; reinforces strictness. |
| **B. Verify oil & fry stations** | “Can you confirm that the fry station uses **dedicated, gluten‑free oil** or that the item will be **grilled/oven‑baked** instead of fried?” | Prevents exposure to wheat‑floured batters cooked in shared oil (high‑risk zone). |
| **C. Ask about breading & batter** | “Is this dish **breaded, battered, or coated** with any wheat‑ or barley‑based flour? If so, can it be prepared **without the coating** or swapped for a **gluten‑free alternative** (e.g., corn‑starch or almond flour)?” | Eliminates regular pasta, breaded items, and hidden wheat flour. |
| **D. Request ingredient list** | “Could you provide a **full ingredient list**, especially for sauces and dressings? I need to confirm that they’re **certified gluten‑free** (e.g., tamari instead of soy sauce).” | Ensures no hidden gluten in sauces; aligns with “use tamari” recommendation [[entities/tamari]]. |
| **E. Demand separate utensils & prep area** | “Will the kitchen use **dedicated cutting boards, knives, and utensils** for my gluten‑free items, and will the preparation surface be **wiped clean** before cooking?” | Directly applies the **dedicated equipment** rule from the cross‑contamination concept. |
| **F. Confirm plating & serving** | “Will the plate be **served on a clean, gluten‑free plate** with **individual utensils** (no shared tongs or knives)?” | Prevents cross‑contact at the table. |
| **G. Re‑state the requirement** | “Just to be clear, the whole order must contain **no wheat, barley, or any food that has been fried in shared oil**. If that can’t be guaranteed, I’ll need to choose another dish.” | Gives the kitchen a final checkpoint. |
| **H. Thank & document** | “Thank you for taking these steps. Could you note the modifications on the order ticket for the kitchen staff?” | Creates a written trail, reinforcing compliance. |

> **Tip:** Keep a printed copy of the script on hand or save it on your phone; hand it to the server if needed.

## 2️⃣ One‑Week Gluten‑Free Meal Plan (Zero Wheat/Barley, No Shared‑Fry Oil)

The plan draws entirely from naturally gluten‑free foods highlighted in the vegetarian menu [[summaries/session‑12_2024‑06‑15]]. No pasta, breaded items, or fried foods are used. All cooking is done **grilled, roasted, sautéed in fresh oil, or boiled**.

| Day | Breakfast | Lunch | Dinner | Snack / Dessert |
|-----|-----------|-------|--------|-----------------|
| **Mon** | Greek‑style yogurt + mixed berries + 1 tbsp **tamari‑marinated** sliced cucumber | Quinoa salad with **french‑green‑lentils**, cherry tomatoes, baby spinach, olive oil & lemon | Roasted **halloumi** & mixed veg tray bake (zucchini, bell pepper, red onion) – baked on a clean sheet (see main dish in menu) | Apple slices with **gluten‑free crackers** and almond butter |
| **Tue** | Smoothie bowl (banana, almond milk, chia seeds, topped with **gluten‑free crackers** crumbles) | Lentil & herb salad (pre‑cooked **french‑green‑lentils**, parsley, mint, vinaigrette) | Grilled portobello “steak” with chimichurri, side of steamed broccoli | **Flourless‑chocolate‑cake** square (made ahead, see dessert) |
| **Wed** | Scrambled eggs with sautéed spinach & diced **halloumi** | Mixed greens + caprese skewers (basil, mozzarella, cherry tomato, drizzle tamari) | Stir‑fried rice‑free “cabbage noodles” with tamari, carrots, snap peas (use fresh oil) | Fresh fruit salad + a handful of **gluten‑free crackers** |
| **Thu** | Overnight oats made with certified gluten‑free oats, almond milk, maple syrup, berries | Warm **lentil‑herb** soup (reuse day‑2 lentils) + side salad | Baked sweet‑potato wedges (olive oil, rosemary) + **halloumi** slices (grilled) | **Flourless‑chocolate‑cake** piece |
| **Fri** | Avocado toast on **gluten‑free bread** (store‑bought, certified) + radish slices | Chickpea “tuna” salad (mashed chickpeas, celery, tamari, lemon) in lettuce cups | Veggie‑filled **frittata** (zucchini, bell pepper, hall halloumi) – oven‑baked | Carrot sticks with **whipped feta dip** (from menu) |
| **Sat** | Cottage cheese + pineapple chunks + **gluten‑free crackers** | Roasted veg & **halloumi** tray (repeat of main) + side of quinoa | **Caprese skewers** + mixed greens with vinaigrette | **Flourless‑chocolate‑cake** bite |
| **Sun** | Smoothie (spinach, avocado, almond milk, cocoa powder) | **Gluten‑free crackers** & cheese board (halloumi, goat cheese, grapes) – keep crackers separate per cross‑contamination checklist | **Lentil & herb salad** (leftover lentils) topped with toasted pumpkin seeds | Fresh berries with a dollop of whipped feta |

### Key Safety Practices (apply every day)

| Practice | Source |
|----------|--------|
| Use **dedicated cutting boards, knives, and oil** for all gluten‑free prep. | [[concepts/cross‑contamination‑prevention]] |
| **Wipe** grill/griddle and cooking surfaces before each use. | Same |
| Store **gluten‑free crackers** in a sealed container separate from any grain‑based crackers. | Same |
| Label any *modified* dishes (e.g., “no batter”) on the plate. | Same |
| Verify all packaged items (spices, sauces) carry a **certified gluten‑free** label. | Same |
| Avoid any *shared fryer* – use **fresh oil** for sauté or **oven‑roast** instead. | Same |

### Quick Reference Grocery List (derived from the menu)

- **Proteins:** Halloumi, feta, Greek yogurt, eggs, cottage cheese, tamari (gluten‑free soy sauce)  
- **Grains/Legumes:** French‑green lentils, quinoa, certified gluten‑free oats, gluten‑free crackers, gluten‑free bread (if desired)  
- **Produce:** All fresh vegetables (zucchini, carrots, bell peppers, broccoli, spinach, kale, tomatoes, avocado, berries, apples, pineapple, citrus) and herbs (parsley, mint, cilantro)  
- **Fats & Seasonings:** Olive oil, butter, honey, cumin, rosemary, lemon, tamari, salt, pepper  
- **Dessert:** Dark chocolate, butter, sugar (for flourless‑chocolate‑cake)  

---

### Bottom Line

- **Restaurant:** Use the scripted dialogue to guarantee that dishes are prepared without wheat, barley, or shared‑oil frying, and that dedicated equipment is used.  
- **Home meals:** Follow the 7‑day plan, which contains only naturally gluten‑free ingredients and strictly avoids pasta, breaded foods, and any shared fry oil. All steps align with the cross‑contamination prevention strategies and the vegetarian gluten‑free menu you already have [[summaries/session‑12_2024‑06‑15]], ensuring **zero gluten exposure** for a celiac‑safe week.
